name: Saint John Henry Newman
history: The leading Anglican thinker of his age, Newman followed his study of the early Church into the Catholic Church in 1845, at great personal cost. He founded the Birmingham Oratory, wrote The Idea of a University and The Dream of Gerontius, and was made a cardinal in 1879. He was canonised in 2019.
prayer: Lead, kindly Light, amid the encircling gloom, lead Thou me on! The night is dark, and I am far from home; lead Thou me on! Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see the distant scene; one step enough for me.
meditation: One step enough for me. What is the one step God is asking of you today?
